say:0:1423304001:0.text: We might as well stop by the Lunaris Altar and see what's going on—if only to put Ravion's mind at ease.
say:0:1423304001:0.source_cn: 沙利叶既然不放心祭司们，我们就去银月祭庭看看吧。

say:0:1423305001:0.text: There are quite a few priestesses here. Want to listen in and see what they're chatting about?
say:0:1423305001:0.source_cn: 这里有不少祭司呢，我们去听听这些人的谈话？

say:1:1423309001:1.text: ... You said you received a revelation last night. Did it come from her Majesty...?
say:1:1423309001:1.source_cn: ……祭司大人，您说您昨天晚上接收到了神谕，难道说，是女...

say:2:1423309002:1.text: Watch your words. The gods don't take kindly to loose talk.
say:2:1423309002:1.source_cn: 不可妄言，以免对神明不敬。

say:3:1423309003:1.text: A true revelation only comes from a true deity. It was Misarte, the Goddess of the Earth and Rivers, who spoke to me.
say:3:1423309003:1.source_cn: 所谓神谕，自然是来自真正的神明。昨夜授意我的，是大地与...

say:4:1423309004:1.text: Misarte has forgiven Essail. All we have to do is return to our faith, and the blessings will follow.
say:4:1423309004:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒已向我降下神谕，祂已经原谅了艾塞勒，只要我们重新...

say:5:1423309005:1.text: But what exactly do I need to do to earn her blessing?
say:5:1423309005:1.source_cn: 可我要怎么做才能得到弥萨忒大人的赐福……

say:6:1423309006:1.text: ... She gave me a sacred mission—to rebuild her church and restore faith in her across Sal'thorin.
say:6:1423309006:1.source_cn: ……弥萨忒大人委以我一项重任，祂命我建立教派，恢复萨洛...

say:7:1423309007:1.text: That's incredible. She entrusted something so important to you?!
say:7:1423309007:1.source_cn: 您被委以了这样的重任？！

say:8:1423309008:1.text: It's a difficult undertaking, yes... Just getting the funds together is a challenge. But I'm committed to it for the rest of my life.
say:8:1423309008:1.source_cn: 确实是艰难的工作……在资金方面就有不小缺口，但我会用毕...

say:9:1423309009:1.text: Of course, I wouldn't turn down any help. Whether it's financial support or simply someone to share the burden, it would mean the world.
say:9:1423309009:1.source_cn: 如果能有伙伴一起为这伟大的事业努力，抑或提供一些帮助…...

say:10:1423309010:1.text: I-I'm not much good at anything else, but if you're short on money, I'd love to help fund something this meaningful!
say:10:1423309010:1.source_cn: 我、我别的不在行，资金方面您缺多少钱？如果您不嫌弃的话...

say:11:1423309011:1.text: Your sincerity is deeply moving. As a sign of gratitude, I would like to name you as an honorary elder of the church.
say:11:1423309011:1.source_cn: 您的虔诚令我叹服，为了表达我的诚意与感谢，我正式邀请您...

say:12:1423309012:1.text: Honorary elder? I never imagined I'd be offered something like that.
say:12:1423309012:1.source_cn: 荣誉长老……我想都不敢想……

choice_prompt:13:1423309012.text: Honorary elder? I never imagined I'd be offered something like that.
choice_prompt:13:1423309012.source_cn: 荣誉长老……我想都不敢想……

say:14:1423309013:1.text: You...? Wait, I didn't realize... You're Magister Merlin!
say:14:1423309013:1.male: You...? Wait, I didn't realize... You're Magister Merlin!
say:14:1423309013:1.female: You...? Wait, I didn't realize... You're Magister Merlin!

say:15:1423309014:1.text: Ah, suddenly remembered something I need to do. Excuse me!
say:15:1423309014:1.source_cn: 我想起我还有点事，我先走了！

say:17:1423309015:1.text: Wait! Priestess! What about my elder title?!
say:17:1423309015:1.source_cn: 哎，大人，祭司大人！我的荣誉长老！

say:19:1423309016:1.text: She made the whole thing up. There was no revelation.
say:19:1423309016:1.source_cn: 她只是在骗你啦，才没有什么神谕呢。

say:20:1423309017:1.text: Really...? I trusted her. I confessed so many things to her... and gave her so much...
say:20:1423309017:1.source_cn: 是这样的吗……？我之前向这位祭司大人告解过好几次，也向...
say:20:1423309017:1.male: Really...? I trusted her. I confessed so many things to her... and gave her so much...
say:20:1423309017:1.female: Really...? I trusted her. I confessed so many things to her... and gave her so much...

say:21:1423309018:1.text: So all this time she was lying to me?
say:21:1423309018:1.male: So all this time she was lying to me?
say:21:1423309018:1.female: So all this time she was lying to me?

choice_prompt:22:1423309018.text: So all this time she was lying to me?
choice_prompt:22:1423309018.male: So all this time she was lying to me?
choice_prompt:22:1423309018.female: So all this time she was lying to me?

say:23:1423309019:1.source_cn: 我、我会的。谢谢您，梅林大人……

choice:22:0:1.text: If you see her again, go to the guards.
choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 下次见到她，记得报告卫队
choice:22:0:1.male: If you see her again, go to the guards.
choice:22:0:1.female: If you see her again, go to the guards.

choice:13:0:1.text: So, if I donate too, do I get to be an honorary elder?
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 我出钱也可以当荣誉长老吗？
choice:13:0:1.male: So, if I donate too, do I get to be an honorary elder?
choice:13:0:1.female: So, if I donate too, do I get to be an honorary elder?

say:3:1423310001:1.text: What do you mean, make things right?
say:3:1423310001:1.source_cn: 你说想要弥补过错……是什么意思？

say:4:1423310002:1.text: Oh, it's you, Magister, and your familiars...
say:4:1423310002:1.source_cn: 啊，是梅林大人和两位使魔……
say:4:1423310002:1.male: Oh, it's you, Magister, and your familiars...
say:4:1423310002:1.female: Oh, it's you, Magister, and your familiars...

say:5:1423310003:1.text: As a priestess, I used to punish those who didn't show proper reverence for the so-called divine blessings.
say:5:1423310003:1.source_cn: 作为祭司，我曾经的工作就是对那些不敬恩典之人施加惩戒。

say:6:1423310004:1.text: But those blessings were lies, crafted by the Queen. I don't even want to think about how many lives I destroyed in her name.
say:6:1423310004:1.source_cn: 可所谓的恩典，都是女王构设的谎言，我不敢想，为了女王所...

say:7:1423310005:1.text: I want to help the people I once hurt. I want to undo the lies I used to believe in. But I don't know how to begin...
say:7:1423310005:1.source_cn: 我想做些什么，去弥补那些我伤害过的人，去纠正那些我过去...

say:8:1423310006:1.text: Well... Maybe start with what you know best. If you can use your experience to help ordinary people, that'd be a big step.
say:8:1423310006:1.source_cn: 这样啊……你之前最擅长或者最熟悉的事是什么呢？从这些事...

say:9:1423310007:1.text: Ironically, the only thing I knew well was the law—what counted as a crime and how to punish it. That's how I ended up hurting those people...
say:9:1423310007:1.source_cn: 说来可笑，我之前最熟悉的，就是律法中的各项罪名与惩罚，...

choice_prompt:10:1423310007.text: Ironically, the only thing I knew well was the law—what counted as a crime and how to punish it. That's how I ended up hurting those people...
choice_prompt:10:1423310007.source_cn: 说来可笑，我之前最熟悉的，就是律法中的各项罪名与惩罚，我就是依照着它们，去伤害那些人……

say:12:1423310009:1.text: I get it now! What Magister means is, you know better than anyone where the old laws were unfair!
say:12:1423310009:1.source_cn: 我懂了，主人的意思是，那些旧律法不合理的地方，你应该是...
say:12:1423310009:1.male: I get it now! What Magister means is, you know better than anyone where the old laws were unfair!
say:12:1423310009:1.female: I get it now! What Magister means is, you know better than anyone where the old laws were unfair!

say:13:1423310010:1.text: You could use that knowledge to revise laws that unfairly punish commoners and create ones that make their lives better!
say:13:1423310010:1.source_cn: 是不是刚好可以利用这一点，修订那些对平民不公平的律法，...

say:14:1423310011:1.text: You mean like banning nobles from hiring private armies, making them pay their servants properly, and letting commoners work in any trade they choose...?
say:14:1423310011:1.source_cn: 比如规定贵族无权雇佣私兵，贵族应当给曾经为他们工作的奴...

say:15:1423310012:1.text: Those are great ideas! Ravion mentioned the royal city is overwhelmed with cases. They're looking for experienced clerks. You should apply!
say:15:1423310012:1.source_cn: 都是很棒的想法呢！沙利叶之前提过，现在王城里案件数量激...

say:16:1423310013:1.text: Start as a legal clerk, huh...? Thank you. I'll seriously think about it!
say:16:1423310013:1.source_cn: 从律法事务官开始吗……谢谢你们，我会好好考虑的！

choice:10:0:1.text: Maybe try rewriting the old laws?
choice:10:0:1.male: Maybe try rewriting the old laws?
choice:10:0:1.female: Maybe try rewriting the old laws?

say:1:1423311001:1.text: Priestess, I scouted a few shop locations for you. See if any of them look good to you.
say:1:1423311001:1.source_cn: 祭司大人，我帮您选了几处店面的位置，您看看有没有合适的？

say:2:1423311002:1.text: Let's go with the one in Goodwill Market. It's always busy, so more people will notice the shop.
say:2:1423311002:1.source_cn: 就蒙惠市集这处吧，这里的人流最多，也会有更多的人看到我...

say:3:1423311003:1.text: Don't worry. After the shop opens, I'll still offer free healing potions to you or anyone in need.
say:3:1423311003:1.source_cn: 请不必顾虑，魔药店开业后，如果你或者其他有困难的人需要...

say:4:1423311004:1.text: No, I can't let you do that! I'll make sure to drop by often and support your business!
say:4:1423311004:1.source_cn: 这怎么行！我以后一定多去照顾您的生意！

choice_prompt:5:1423311004.text: No, I can't let you do that! I'll make sure to drop by often and support your business!
choice_prompt:5:1423311004.source_cn: 这怎么行！我以后一定多去照顾您的生意！

say:6:1423311005:2.text: Oh, Magister! Yes, that's exactly what I intend to do.
say:6:1423311005:2.source_cn: 啊，是魔法师大人……正是如此。
say:6:1423311005:2.male: Oh, Magister! Yes, that's exactly what I intend to do.
say:6:1423311005:2.female: Oh, Magister! Yes, that's exactly what I intend to do.

say:7:1423311006:1.text: I once saw you brewing healing potions for the injured. It moved me deeply, and that's when this idea took root.
say:7:1423311006:1.source_cn: 我曾亲眼见过您为病患亲自炼制伤药，那一幕令我动容，也因...
say:7:1423311006:1.male: I once saw you brewing healing potions for the injured. It moved me deeply, and that's when this idea took root.
say:7:1423311006:1.female: I once saw you brewing healing potions for the injured. It moved me deeply, and that's when this idea took root.

say:8:1423311007:1.text: With medicine in short supply across the royal city, I'm planning to open a potion shop—selling potions and ingredients, and teaching others how to make their own.
say:8:1423311007:1.source_cn: 如今王城各类伤药短缺，我想开一家魔药店，售卖魔药成品和...

say:9:1423311008:1.text: Most people in Sal'thorin can use magic. With a little training, they could learn to brew basic potions themselves.
say:9:1423311008:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰大多数人都会使用魔法，只要经过学习，便能掌握配...

say:10:1423311009:1.text: If it goes well, it should greatly relieve the shortage of healing potions in the royal city.
say:10:1423311009:1.source_cn: 这样一来，王城伤药短缺的问题就会大大缓解了吧。

say:12:1423311010:1.text: That sounds amazing! When your shop opens, we'll be your first customers!
say:12:1423311010:1.source_cn: 听起来好棒！等你的魔药店开业，我们也去照顾生意！

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 你想亲自开一家魔药店？

say:0:1423312001:0.text: Sounds like every priestess is starting to find their own path forward...
say:0:1423312001:0.source_cn: 看来祭司们对未来的去向都各有各的主意……

say:1:1423312002:0.text: Hmm? Is that a priestess over there crying?
say:1:1423312002:0.source_cn: 哎，那边怎么有个祭司在哭？

say:1:1423314001:1.text: Are you alright, Miss? Did something happen? Why are you crying?
say:1:1423314001:1.source_cn: 这位祭司小姐，你遇到什么困难了吗？为什么在哭呀？

say:2:1423314002:1.text: *Sobbing*... Are those... hamsters? Great. I've cried so hard I'm hallucinating...
say:2:1423314002:1.source_cn: 呜……呜……我眼前怎么哭出仓鼠了……

say:3:1423314003:1.text: Oh, you're Magister Merlin, the one who lifted the curse! And those are your familiars!
say:3:1423314003:1.source_cn: 啊！你们是、是那位解除了诅咒的魔法师梅林大人！还有<m...
say:3:1423314003:1.male: Oh, you're Magister Merlin, the one who lifted the curse! And those are your familiars!
say:3:1423314003:1.female: Oh, you're Magister Merlin, the one who lifted the curse! And those are your familiars!

say:4:1423314004:1.text: I was talking with a few other priestesses and realized... they've all figured out what to do next. I'm the only one still lost...
say:4:1423314004:1.source_cn: 我哭是因为……跟几位祭司朋友们聊了聊，发现大家想好了出...

say:5:1423314005:1.text: My name is Orlana. I come from a minor noble family and only just became a junior priestess after finishing my apprenticeship.
say:5:1423314005:1.source_cn: 我叫欧罗娜，是小贵族出身，不久前刚从见习祭司正式成为低...

say:6:1423314006:1.text: It's rare for someone without status to become a priestess, so I worked incredibly hard to make it... and now it all feels pointless.
say:6:1423314006:1.source_cn: 一般来说，出身平凡的人是很难成为祭司的，我努力了那么久...

say:7:1423314007:1.text: The Queen and the High Priestess are gone. All the scriptures I memorized, the laws, the rituals, the years I spent mastering spells—it was all for nothing!
say:7:1423314007:1.source_cn: 奎茵冕下和女王都不在了，我读了那么多典籍，背了那么多女...

choice_prompt:8:1423314007.text: The Queen and the High Priestess are gone. All the scriptures I memorized, the laws, the rituals, the years I spent mastering spells—it was all for nothing!
choice_prompt:8:1423314007.source_cn: 奎茵冕下和女王都不在了，我读了那么多典籍，背了那么多女王颂词、律法条文、礼仪约束，苦练了那么久施法的术式，都没用了！

say:9:1423314008:1.text: I'm not blaming you! It's just that I don't have a job anymore. My parents worry about me all the time, so I came out here to clear my head.
say:9:1423314008:1.source_cn: 不是您的错！……总之，我现在没有工作，父母每天都满脸哀...
say:9:1423314008:1.male: I'm not blaming you! It's just that I don't have a job anymore. My parents worry about me all the time, so I came out here to clear my head.
say:9:1423314008:1.female: I'm not blaming you! It's just that I don't have a job anymore. My parents worry about me all the time, so I came out here to clear my head.

say:10:1423314009:1.text: We heard a lot of priestesses talking about their next steps—some want to become legal clerks, others are opening potion shops...
say:10:1423314009:1.source_cn: 我们刚刚也听到很多祭司在讨论出路的事呢，比如去做事务官...

say:11:1423314010:1.text: Orlana, do any of those sound interesting to you?
say:11:1423314010:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜对这些感兴趣吗？

say:12:1423314011:1.text: They all sound so great... but I don't think I'm good enough for any of them.
say:12:1423314011:1.source_cn: 都是些好厉害的工作……我觉得我无法胜任。

say:13:1423314012:1.text: Priestess Leena always said my potions were dangerous, and that my written prayers were too plain and unrefined.
say:13:1423314012:1.source_cn: 我配的魔药总被丽娜祭司说是危险品，写的书文也被批评辞藻...

say:14:1423314013:1.text: All I really have is book knowledge. I've barely done anything hands-on...
say:14:1423314013:1.source_cn: 毕竟我只学了些纸面上的知识，没有什么实践经验……

say:16:1423314014:1.text: Is there something else you'd like to do? Maybe go somewhere relaxing, or just have some real fun for once?
say:16:1423314014:1.source_cn: 那你有别的想做的事吗？比如想去哪散散心，痛痛快快玩一场...

say:17:1423314015:1.text: Yeah, you've probably worked hard for years just to become a priestess.
say:17:1423314015:1.source_cn: 对呀，你为了成为祭司，应该辛苦努力了很久吧。

choice_prompt:18:1423314015.text: Yeah, you've probably worked hard for years just to become a priestess.
choice_prompt:18:1423314015.source_cn: 对呀，你为了成为祭司，应该辛苦努力了很久吧。

say:19:1423314016:1.text: Actually, I've always been curious about the southern part of the Lunaris Altar, the area where the commoners live...
say:19:1423314016:1.source_cn: 说到这个，我有点想去银月祭庭的南边，也就是平民生活的地...

say:20:1423314017:1.text: I've lived my whole life in the royal city and priestess quarters, so I know this place like the back of my hand. I wanted to see what the commoners' district was like, but I wasn't allowed to.
say:20:1423314017:1.source_cn: 我一直生活在王城和祭司区，对这里的角角落落都再熟悉不过...

say:21:1423314018:1.text: Lately a lot of commoners have moved into the royal city. I'd really like to see where and how they live.
say:21:1423314018:1.source_cn: 最近许多平民都来到了王城生活，我也有点想去他们居住的地...

say:22:1423314019:1.text: But the commoners' district is supposed to be dangerous. I couldn't go alone... so I just kept the idea to myself.
say:22:1423314019:1.source_cn: 但那是很危险的地方……我一个人去肯定不行，只能在心里想...

say:23:1423314020:1.text: It's not that dangerous anymore. Since the curse was lifted, there have been far fewer monsters, and restoration of the commoners' district has already begun...
say:23:1423314020:1.source_cn: 其实也没有那么危险啦……孽化的诅咒解除之后，游荡的怪物...

say:24:1423314021:0.text: If you're still scared, we can go with you. Whatever danger lies ahead, the Magister can handle it! And as a knight, Chippy will protect you too!
say:24:1423314021:0.source_cn: 如果你还是害怕的话，我们可以陪你去！有什么危险主人都能...
say:24:1423314021:0.male: If you're still scared, we can go with you. Whatever danger lies ahead, the Magister can handle it! And as a knight, Chippy will protect you too!
say:24:1423314021:0.female: If you're still scared, we can go with you. Whatever danger lies ahead, the Magister can handle it! And as a knight, Chippy will protect you too!

say:25:1423314022:1.text: You're all a lot more kind and down-to-earth than I thought... If you don't mind coming with me, I'd feel a whole lot better.
say:25:1423314022:1.source_cn: 没想到你们会这么平易近人……如果你们愿意的话，那就再好...

say:26:1423314023:1.text: I don't really want to go home yet... If we go today, would that work for you? Should I bring anything along?
say:26:1423314023:1.source_cn: 我不太想现在就回家……如果今天就去的话，你们有时间吗？...

say:27:1423314024:1.text: We're good to go whenever you are! As for what to bring... well, all you need is us.
say:27:1423314024:1.source_cn: 随时可以出发！要准备的东西嘛……带上我们就好啦。

say:28:1423314025:1.text: Alright, then let's get going! Chippy will scout ahead!
say:28:1423314025:1.source_cn: 那我们就出发咯？满满走前面为你们探路！

choice:18:0:1.text: It's a chance to take a break.
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 刚好趁此机会休息一下
choice:18:0:1.male: It's a chance to take a break.
choice:18:0:1.female: It's a chance to take a break.

choice:18:1:2.text: Think of this as a well-earned vacation.
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 把这段时间当作难得的假期
choice:18:1:2.male: Think of this as a well-earned vacation.
choice:18:1:2.female: Think of this as a well-earned vacation.

choice:8:0:1.text: So this is all because of me.
choice:8:0:1.male: So this is all because of me.
choice:8:0:1.female: So this is all because of me.

say:0:1423315001:0.text: Is there anywhere in particular you want to see, Orlana? We can take you there!
say:0:1423315001:0.source_cn: 欧罗娜有对具体哪里感兴趣吗？我们可以带你去看！

say:1:1423315002:0.text: Wow, the Sporeveil Grove is bigger than I thought... I don't really have a destination in mind. Maybe we should ask someone around here.
say:1:1423315002:0.source_cn: 原来暮菌林地这么大……我也没什么目标，要不问问路人吧。

say:1:1423316001:1.text: Excuse me, could I ask you something...

say:2:1423316002:1.text: Hey, aren't you that clumsy apprentice priestess?!
say:2:1423316002:1.source_cn: 哎，你是那个笨手笨脚的见习祭司！

say:3:1423316003:1.text: I'm not an apprentice anymore. I was promoted to junior priestess. Or... well, I guess I'm not really a priestess at all now...
say:3:1423316003:1.source_cn: 我现在已经不是见习祭司了，已经被升任为低阶祭司……哦不...

say:5:1423316005:1.text: Don't you remember me? I'm Nadine. I got into a bit of trouble in the royal city and the priestesses caught me. You were the one who put that Stigma of Judgment on me.
say:5:1423316005:1.source_cn: 你忘记了呀，我叫奈琳，当初在王城犯了点小错，被抓起来交...

say:6:1423316006:1.text: Oh, I remember now. You were that servant! I—I'm really sorry...
say:6:1423316006:1.source_cn: 哦，我想起来了，你是那位仆从！对、对不起……

say:7:1423316007:1.text: Priestess Leena told me to practice the Stigma of Judgment spell, and if I didn't, I would've failed the evaluation. I'm so sorry...
say:7:1423316007:1.source_cn: 当时丽娜祭司让我练习施加惩罚印记的术式，不这样的话考核...

say:8:1423316008:1.text: It's alright. You clearly needed the practice.

say:10:1423316010:1.text: You tried casting the spell so many times and kept doing it wrong. You were shaking like a leaf! It was kind of hilarious, to be honest!
say:10:1423316010:1.source_cn: 因为你当时不是施了好几次术式都没有成功，紧张得全身都在...

say:11:1423316011:1.text: No need to dwell on it, though. I left the royal city not long before the Queen died. I guess I got out just in time to escape the chaos.
say:11:1423316011:1.source_cn: 你不用把那件事放在心上，我离开王城没多久，女王就崩逝了...

say:12:1423316012:1.text: So what brings you to the commoners' district? Don't tell me you came all this way looking for me.
say:12:1423316012:1.source_cn: 所以你怎么会来到平民区？总不会是特意来找我的吧？

say:13:1423316013:1.text: I'm not a priestess anymore, and I haven't found a new job... These friends came with me to help me clear my head.
say:13:1423316013:1.source_cn: 我现在已经不是祭司了，又找不到能从事的其他工作……这几...

say:14:1423316014:1.text: Clear your head? I'm afraid you picked the wrong place for that—no warm tea, no tasty snacks, just the occasional monster leaping out at you.
say:14:1423316014:1.source_cn: 散心？这里可不是散心的好地方，没有烹好的热茶和甜点，偶...

say:15:1423316015:1.text: Anyway, I'm off to hunt. If you're just here to relax, stay nearby and head back before it gets dark.
say:15:1423316015:1.source_cn: 我还要去狩猎，你们想散心的话，就在这附近逛逛，早点回去吧。

say:18:1423316017:1.text: She might run into trouble on her own. And to be honest, I've never seen anyone hunt before. I'm a little curious...
say:18:1423316017:1.source_cn: 她一个人也不知道会不会遇到危险。而且我从来没见过狩猎的...

choice_prompt:19:1423316017.text: She might run into trouble on her own. And to be honest, I've never seen anyone hunt before. I'm a little curious...
choice_prompt:19:1423316017.source_cn: 她一个人也不知道会不会遇到危险。而且我从来没见过狩猎的场面，有点好奇……

say:20:1423316018:2.text: Let's go. We might still catch up to her.
say:20:1423316018:2.source_cn: 我们顺着奈琳离开的方向找找她吧。

say:0:1423317001:0.text: She went east. Come on, let's move!
say:0:1423317001:0.source_cn: 奈琳往东边去了，我们跟上她吧！

say:0:1423318001:0.text: Nadine's in trouble. Hurry, we need to help her!
say:0:1423318001:0.source_cn: 奈琳有危险，我们快去帮忙！

say:2:1423319001:1.text: Oh, it's you! Didn't think you had it in you. You looked way too soft to be this tough.
say:2:1423319001:1.source_cn: 是你们啊，真看不出来你们这么厉害。我还以为你们跟看起来...

say:3:1423319002:1.text: That capshroom was a vicious one. Thanks to you, I didn't end up as its lunch.
say:3:1423319002:1.source_cn: 这次要捕猎的幻灵孢菇十分凶猛，如果不是有你们，可能真要...

say:4:1423319003:1.text: I read that these things attack with spores and mess with your mind using illusions. Turns out the books were right.
say:4:1423319003:1.source_cn: 我在书里读到过，幻灵孢菇会用孢子攻击人类，还会制造欺骗...

say:5:1423319004:1.text: I had no idea people actually hunt them for food.
say:5:1423319004:1.source_cn: 但是人们会狩猎它作为食物，这我还是第一次知道。

say:6:1423319005:1.text: In the commoners' district, you learn not to be picky. If it moves, it's probably dinner.
say:6:1423319005:1.source_cn: 毕竟平民区没有那么多可以吃的东西嘛。

say:7:1423319006:1.text: Sorry, we didn't help you catch it... Are you going to starve?
say:7:1423319006:1.source_cn: 我们没有帮你抓到它……你是不是要饿肚子了？

say:8:1423319007:1.text: It's fine. Happens all the time. I'll try fishing instead. Want to tag along?
say:8:1423319007:1.source_cn: 没那么糟糕，狩猎失败是常有的事。我想想，要不钓条鱼来填...

say:9:1423319008:1.text: Fishing? I've never done that before. I just buy my fish at the market...
say:9:1423319008:1.source_cn: 钓鱼吗？可是我从来没有钓过鱼，我吃的鱼都是从市集买来的……

say:10:1423319009:1.text: Market fish come from commoners like us, you know. You really can't fish? That's... kind of sad.
say:10:1423319009:1.source_cn: 那些鱼都是平民钓起来送到城里的啦。原来你连钓鱼都不会，...

say:13:1423319011:1.text: Alright, lead the way! Let's go find this fish pond!
say:13:1423319011:1.source_cn: 好，我们跟你一起去鱼塘！

say:14:1423319012:1.text: No pond around here, but there's a stream that'll do. Come on, I'll show you.
say:14:1423319012:1.source_cn: 鱼塘没有……倒是有溪流，你们跟我来吧。

choice:12:0:1.text: This is your chance to learn fishing.
choice:12:0:1.male: This is your chance to learn fishing.
choice:12:0:1.female: This is your chance to learn fishing.

choice:12:1:2.text: Time to pick up a survival skill.
choice:12:1:2.male: Time to pick up a survival skill.
choice:12:1:2.female: Time to pick up a survival skill.

say:0:1423320001:0.text: Magister, would you mind showing me how to fish?
say:0:1423320001:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，可以请您为我示范怎样钓鱼吗？
say:0:1423320001:0.male: Magister, would you mind showing me how to fish?
say:0:1423320001:0.female: Magister, would you mind showing me how to fish?

say:1:1423321001:1.text: So I hook the bait, cast it out, and watch the bobber... Got it! Let me give it a try!
say:1:1423321001:1.source_cn: 先往鱼钩上挂上饵料，再甩钩，观察浮漂……我大概了解了。...

narration:2:1423321002:0.text: After a few tries, Orlana finally reels in a small Prism Trout.
narration:2:1423321002:0.source_cn: 练习多次后，欧罗娜终于钓上了一条体型较小的染虹鳟。

say:4:1423321004:0.text: Its scales are colorful, and it has those round spots... It's a Prism Trout! I've read about it in a book, but I've never seen one in real life before!
say:4:1423321004:0.source_cn: 鳞片的颜色五彩斑斓，上面有规律的圆形斑点……这是书上提...

say:7:1423321005:0.text: You really do know your trivia... Now let's turn that fish into lunch.
say:7:1423321005:0.source_cn: 你倒是懂一些杂七杂八的……接下来就该用这些鱼填饱肚子了。

say:8:1423321006:1.text: I'm guessing cooking wasn't part of priestess training?
say:8:1423321006:1.source_cn: 做饭这种事，肯定不在祭司培训的范畴内吧？

say:11:1423321008:1.text: I'll write down every step you take! I want to learn!
say:11:1423321008:1.source_cn: 我一定记录下您的每个步骤，认真学习！
say:11:1423321008:1.male: I'll write down every step you take! I want to learn!
say:11:1423321008:1.female: I'll write down every step you take! I want to learn!

say:12:1423321009:1.text: You can borrow my pot. I've got some seasonings too. Should be enough to make a nice, simple fish soup.
say:12:1423321009:1.source_cn: 那我把锅借给你们吧，还有这些配料和调味品，简单做道鱼汤...

choice:10:0:1.text: Let me show you how it's done.
choice:10:0:1.male: Let me show you how it's done.
choice:10:0:1.female: Let me show you how it's done.

document:0:243:0.text:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Slice the <style="highlight">fuzzy mushroom</style> and add it to the pot. Cook over high heat until the mushroom is fully cooked and releases a rich aroma.
Next, gently place the <style="highlight">fleshy Prism Trout</style> into the pot. Simmer over medium heat to keep the fish tender and intact as it absorbs the rich flavor of the mushroom.
Finally, season with an appropriate amount of <style="highlight">salt</style> to enhance the taste.
document:0:243:0.source_cn:
锅中加入清水煮沸，将<style="highlight">茸茸伞菇</style>切片下入锅中，大火煮至菌菇熟透味浓。
之后将<style="highlight">肥硕的染虹鳟</style>轻放入锅中，用中火炖煮，使鱼肉滑嫩不散，浸入菌菇鲜味。
最后加入适量<style="highlight">白盐</style>调味增鲜。

say:10:1423322001:0.text: Wow, not bad at all! I want to give it a go too!
say:10:1423322001:0.source_cn: 哇！手艺不错嘛！我也来露一手！

narration:11:1423322002:0.text: Nadine quickly sets up a grill with some stones. The fish sizzles on the hot slab, and before long, the smell of perfectly grilled trout fills the air.
narration:11:1423322002:0.source_cn: 奈琳手脚麻利地用石板支起了烤架，鱼肉在石板上滋滋作响，...

say:14:1423322004:1.text: Wow... tastes amazing! It's incredible how you turned simple ingredients into such tasty dishes!
say:14:1423322004:1.source_cn: 唔……大家做的食物都很美味！能简简单单就做出这样的美食...

say:15:1423322005:1.text: People have only ever said good things about my grilled fish. I wonder if I should open a restaurant to sell it in the royal city. It could really take off.
say:15:1423322005:1.source_cn: 我的烤鱼就没有人说不好吃的！现在王城里有没有烤鱼店？没...

say:16:1423322006:1.text: When you open that restaurant, I'll definitely be one of your regular customers.
say:16:1423322006:1.source_cn: 如果你去王城开店的话，我一定会经常去支持你的。

say:17:1423322007:1.text: What about you? Have you figured out what you want to do?
say:17:1423322007:1.source_cn: 那你呢？有想好之后要去做什么吗？

say:18:1423322008:1.text: I spent my whole life preparing to be a priestess—reading, studying magic, memorizing rites.
say:18:1423322008:1.source_cn: 我努力了很多年，从小到大一直在读书，练习术式，为成为一...

say:19:1423322009:1.text: But now all of that feels pointless, and I really have no idea where to go from here...
say:19:1423322009:1.source_cn: 但这些对现在的我来说都没用了，我确实不知道该去做什么……

say:20:1423322010:1.text: It's good to be book-smart. Not like me—I can't even read, let alone write down a menu. If I ever open my restaurant, I'll be coming to you for help.
say:20:1423322010:1.source_cn: 会读书也没什么不好啊，像我连字都不认识，如果以后开烤鱼...

say:21:1423322011:1.text: So what was your life like growing up?
say:21:1423322011:1.source_cn: 那你从小到大是怎样生活的呢？

say:22:1423322012:1.text: Running wild through the woods, mostly. Spent every day figuring out what was safe to eat, how to hunt, how to fish...
say:22:1423322012:1.source_cn: 就在山林里摸爬滚打呗，每天为食物操心，慢慢学着辨认没毒...

say:23:1423322013:1.text: Of course, I had friends in the commoners' district too. We played, goofed around, made up games... I figured that's how everyone grew up.
say:23:1423322013:1.source_cn: 当然，也会和泽被平民区同龄的伙伴们一起玩，一起疯跑，做...

say:24:1423322014:1.text: The commoners' district... Is that where you live?

say:25:1423322015:1.text: Yeah, the district where commoners live. That's where I was raised. Not really a place for sightseeing—you probably wouldn't like it.
say:25:1423322015:1.source_cn: 是平民聚居的地方，也是我长大的地方，可别想着再去那里散...

say:26:1423322016:1.text: ... Oh, okay. Either way, thank you all for spending today with me. I had a really good time!
say:26:1423322016:1.source_cn: ……好、好的。不管怎样，今天你们都陪我过了很特别的一天...

say:28:1423322017:1.text: Don't mention it! We had fun too!
say:28:1423322017:1.source_cn: 不用客气啦！我们也玩得很开心！

narration:29:1423322018:0.text: Even though Orlana still has a lot on her mind, you all enjoy a peaceful afternoon together, relaxing and sharing a simple picnic.
narration:29:1423322018:0.source_cn: 虽然欧罗娜未能完全放下心事，这并不妨碍你们沉浸在野餐的...

say:0:1423323001:0.text: It's getting late. Orlana, let's walk you home.
say:0:1423323001:0.source_cn: 时间差不多啦，欧罗娜，我们送你回去吧。

say:3:1423324001:1.text: Thank you for walking me back, Magister. I had such a great time. I did so many things I've never done before!
say:3:1423324001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，谢谢你们送我回来。今天真的很有趣，我体验了很...
say:3:1423324001:1.male: Thank you for walking me back, Magister. I had such a great time. I did so many things I've never done before!
say:3:1423324001:1.female: Thank you for walking me back, Magister. I had such a great time. I did so many things I've never done before!

say:4:1423324002:1.text: Do you think next time we could go explore the deeper parts of the Sporeveil Grove? Maybe even the commoners' district...
say:4:1423324002:1.source_cn: 下次我们还可以一起去探索暮菌林地吗？比如，泽被平民区……

choice_prompt:5:1423324002.text: Do you think next time we could go explore the deeper parts of the Sporeveil Grove? Maybe even the commoners' district...
choice_prompt:5:1423324002.source_cn: 下次我们还可以一起去探索暮菌林地吗？比如，泽被平民区……

say:6:1423324003:1.text: Hehe, Nadine said you wouldn't like the commoners' district, but Chippy disagrees!
say:6:1423324003:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，虽然奈琳说你不会喜欢泽被平民区，可满满却觉得不一定！

say:7:1423324004:1.text: I wouldn't have had the courage to try any of this without you. Thank you for helping me step out of my comfort zone...
say:7:1423324004:1.source_cn: 多亏有你们，才让我有勇气去一些之前不会去的地方，做一些...

say:8:1423324005:1.text: It's a promise then. See you next time!
say:8:1423324005:1.source_cn: 那我们就这样约定好啦！下次见！
